parse_rating_from_text: parse a 5-tier investment rating from prose text using the parse_rating function
parse_rating_with_default: parse a rating from text and return a custom default when no rating is found
use_ratings_5_tier: use the RATINGS_5_TIER tuple to iterate over the canonical buy overweight hold underweight sell scale
validate_rating_label: validate that extracted text matches a valid 5-tier rating using the parse_rating two-pass strategy
extract_rating_from_markdown: extract a rating from markdown-formatted text that may contain bold wrappers around the rating word
